title: Designing with Claude for Healthcare Professionals
subtitle: Create clear patient leaflets, presentations, posters and staff training material with Anthropic's Claude — safely and professionally.
description: A practical, safety-first course that shows healthcare professionals how to use Claude, Anthropic's AI assistant, to design high-quality communication and education materials. You will learn to write effective prompts, produce plain-language patient information, build presentations and posters, create staff training resources, and check everything for accuracy, readability and patient privacy before it is used.
audience: Doctors, nurses and pharmacists who create patient information or teach colleagues
Allied health professionals (physiotherapists, dietitians, lab and radiology staff)
Hospital administrators, quality and training teams
Medical, nursing and pharmacy students preparing presentations and posters
Anyone in healthcare who is new to AI and wants a safe, structured start
outcomes: Explain what Claude is, what it does well, and where it can be wrong
Apply a simple framework to write clear, reliable prompts for healthcare tasks
Draft plain-language patient leaflets at an appropriate reading level
Plan and design professional presentations, posters and infographics
Build staff training material, case scenarios and quizzes in a fraction of the time
Protect patient privacy by de-identifying information and following institutional policy
Check AI-generated content for clinical accuracy, bias and readability before use
Set up a repeatable, documented workflow your team can trust
prerequisites: No AI or technical experience needed
A free Claude account (we show you how to create one)
A laptop, tablet or phone with an internet connection

faqs.question: Do I need a paid Claude subscription?
faqs.answer: No. Every exercise in this course can be completed with a free Claude account. Some features, such as larger file uploads or higher usage limits, are easier on a paid plan, and we point these out where relevant.

faqs.question: Is this course specific to one country's regulations?
faqs.answer: The course teaches principles that apply everywhere — de-identification, verification and following institutional policy. We give examples from different settings, but you must always follow the laws and policies that apply where you work.

faqs.question: How long do I have access?
faqs.answer: Once your enrolment is approved you have lifetime access to the course, including future updates to the lessons.

faqs.question: Will I receive a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you complete every lesson you can download a certificate of completion with a unique verification ID that employers can check online.

faqs.question: Can my hospital enrol a group of staff?
faqs.answer: Yes. Visit our For Institutions page to request group pricing, live training sessions and progress reporting.
